text: Official Python client/CLI installable via pip (edison-client)
API key authentication obtainable from user profile page
quote: Authentication is done by providing an API key, which can be obtained directly from your profile page in the Edison platform

text: Users can create new API tokens via an 'API Tokens' section
Can submit literature-review tasks programmatically via API with job name and query
Kosmos agent autonomously reads literature, writes/executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a cited report
quote: Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.

text: Every conclusion is auditable back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it
quote: Every conclusion is fully auditable. You can trace any finding back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it.

text: Can ask a complex scientific question for a high-accuracy cited answer or request a deep literature review synthesizing conflicting evidence across many papers
quote: You can ask it a complex scientific question and get a high-accuracy, cited response, or task it with a deep literature review synthesizing conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers.

text: Turns raw experimental data into detailed analyses, statistical results, and publication-ready figures
quote: It turns raw data into detailed analyses, statistical results, and publication-ready figures.

text: Precedent agent checks novelty of a research idea by searching across fields and identifying gaps
quote: Precedent determines whether a research idea has been tried before. It searches across fields to assess novelty and identify gaps

text: Molecules agent specializes in molecular design and chemistry analysis
quote: Molecules is a chemistry-focused agent for molecular design and analysis.

text: API supports running submitted tasks to completion (run_tasks_until_done)

quote: It accesses 175M+ papers, trials, and patents with native understanding of citation graphs, journal quality, and clinical trial data.

text: Specializes in processing complex experimental datasets like flow cytometry and RNA-seq
quote: specializes in processing complex experimental data, including flow cytometry, RNA-seq, and other biological datasets

text: Offers a generous free tier for academic researchers
